title: Dashboard Data Flow
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of Flask/static UI, query outputs, and charts, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in retail-sales-forecasting.
learning_objectives: Explain Flask/static UI, query outputs, and charts in plain language and connect it to index.html; js/app.js; app.py.
Trace one input through the dashboard data flow stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: Flask/static UI, query outputs, and charts
practical_outcomes: Trace the dashboard data flow stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for Flask/static UI, query outputs, and charts.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
